title: 13-year-old boy beaten to death over alleged theft of biscuits in Odisha; shop owner, son arrested

ai.summary: A 13-year-old boy died after allegedly stealing biscuits in Odisha, leading to police arresting a shop owner and his son. Villagers and family members protested with the boy's body demanding action.

facts.claim: A 13-year-old boy was allegedly beaten to death over the theft of a packet of biscuits in Odisha's Baleshwar district
facts.quote: A 13-year-old boy was allegedly beaten to death over the theft of a packet of biscuits in Odisha's Baleshwar district, following which police arrested a shop owner and his son, officials said on Monday.

facts.claim: The arrests came a day after villagers and family members of the deceased staged a protest with the boy's body, demanding stringent action
facts.quote: The arrests came a day after villagers and family members of the deceased staged a protest with the boy's body, demanding stringent action against those responsible for his death.

facts.claim: The 12-hour-long dharna was called off after senior district administration officials intervened and assured the protesters of strict action
facts.quote: The 12-hour-long dharna was called off after senior district administration officials intervened and assured the protesters of strict action.

facts.claim: The body was handed over to the family on Sunday following a post-mortem examination at the Baleshwar District Headquarters Hospital
facts.quote: The body was handed over to the family on Sunday following a post-mortem examination at the Baleshwar District Headquarters Hospital.
